placeholders.why: The ecommerce URL provider activation block, verbatim, for merging into the host's Files/GlobalSettings.config. /Globalsettings/System/Url/Providers is EMPTY on a stock DW10 install - friendly ecommerce URLs are opt-in - so without it every product and group link a composed storefront renders is a querystring (/en-us/shop?GroupID=...&ProductID=...) and no friendly PDP URL resolves (Foundry 1281). A layer cannot ship GlobalSettings.config itself - the files overlay is overwrite-wins and would replace the host's connection and licence configuration - so the block ships as a fragment with its apply, union and proof steps in-file. Merged by the Foundry harness as a comma-list UNION and live only after a host restart.
